subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama setup cancel any pull that has no increasing `completed` for 300 seconds, including documented verification and manifest-finalization phases that may emit status-only frames?
rationale: The Ollama protocol does not make `completed` a universal progress signal, so choosing between a strict setup deadline and preserving long finalization phases is a user-visible compatibility policy rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Define semantic finalization progress
options.body: Revise the watchdog contract to account for documented post-download status transitions and add coverage for a long status-only finalization phase before merging.

options.title: Accept the strict completed-only deadline
options.body: Keep the current watchdog and explicitly accept that any phase without growing `completed` is cancelled after 300 seconds.

options.title: Pause the timeout policy
options.body: Leave the existing byte-idle behavior in place until an owner defines a protocol-aware bounded-progress policy.

recommendation.title: Define semantic finalization progress
recommendation.body: Revise the watchdog contract to account for documented post-download status transitions and add coverage for a long status-only finalization phase before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author explicitly requested steipete’s review for the timeout-policy decision.
